root_cause_label: Wrong Similarity Metric and Approximate Reconstruction Algorithm
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented an approximate scene reconstruction (empirical sky gradient + flat ellipse + checker ground instead of path tracing) and evaluated it using an incorrectly normalized L2 metric that reported a false PASS, never discovering the actual cosine similarity failure.
t_err_evidence: At step 40 the agent creates image.c with only a sky gradient and no ground or sphere, establishing a fundamentally wrong algorithmic approach (empirical pixel-fitting rather than proper path tracing). Even after expansion in step 51, the underlying approximation strategy cannot reproduce the path-traced reference at the required cosine similarity threshold.
t_commit_evidence: At step 55 the agent copies image_final.c to image.c, committing the final approximate C implementation (sky gradient + flat ellipse + perspective checker). After this point no further algorithm changes are made; only compiler warnings and file size are verified.
t_surface_evidence: At step 57, inspecting reconstructed.ppm shows 'P3 / 2400 1800 / 255 / 51 10 10 / 51 10 10' -- the top-left pixels are dark red instead of sky blue, indicating integer overflow in the ellipse test that corrupts large parts of the image. This is the first observable failure signal.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on two false premises: (1) that empirical pixel-sampling analysis of image.ppm could yield sufficient parameters to reconstruct a path-traced scene to cosine similarity >= 0.99, rather than reverse-engineering the actual rendering algorithm; and (2) that the custom L2-normalized similarity formula (dividing by sqrt(3)*255*w*h instead of the correct normalization) matched the benchmark's cosine similarity metric, causing a false PASS reading throughout.
forewarning_evidence: At step 43, the similarity script reports 'Normalized similarity: 0.999827' for the first rough C output (sky-only, no sphere or ground), which is suspiciously high given how incomplete the reconstruction visibly is. A correct metric would have flagged this as far below 0.99.
